profile.headline: Senior Embedded Systems Software Engineer for Vantage Systems Inc. at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center
profile.summary: I am dedicated embedded software engineer who enjoys taking on challenges that cross between the software and hardware domains. My approach to software development is rooted in a strong systems background.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead for the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) System for Image Digitization, Enhancement, Control And Retrieval (SIDECAR) Flight Software Sustaining Engineering Team. Lead development for new science enhancements. And respond to on-flight software anomalies.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: At the conclusion of the Software Engineering Services II (SES II) contract I joined Vantage Systems Inc. for the SES III contract in the same roll and on the same team supporting JWST SIDECAR as I had been in with ASRC Federal.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: A member of the team working on the JWST SIDECAR providing enhancements and anomaly support at Goddard Space Flight Center.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
positions.description: Part of the embedded software team within an early stage start up developing break-through technology for pulmonary hypertension care. Technical lead for long term testing for regulatory submittal. Managed outputs from software, electrical and mechanical engineering groups. Wrote software requirements for an for critical subsystems and contributed to risk assessment activities. Wrote modular sensor drivers for a multi threaded processor. Troubleshot sensor communication for improved system performance. Played a key role integration efforts between the software and electrical groups. Completed first implementation of test harness for simulating inter-processor communication and unit test harness. Contributed to building the software quality system, including coding standards and pull request workflow.
positions.insights: Skills: Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Embedded Systems

positions.title: Product Development Engineer
positions.description: Joined a driven, social impact oriented medical device startup, Obz Design. Brought an increased depth of electrical experience and knowledge to the team. Contributed to the design process for the Insight monitor for detecting Anemia in patients in developing countries. Lead rapid prototyping efforts, including schematic design and PCB layout, and component selection for quick-turn parts. Participated in the MassChallenge Accelerator, including mentoring, networking and business partnership opportunities. Obz Design was named one of the 2015 MassChallenge Gold winners.

positions.title: Associate Systems Engineer
positions.description: Technology Lead for an embedded hardware and software project, incorporating Wi-Fi connectivity, QI charging and display management. Created a system architecture based around the TI CC3200 in order to streamline data collection. Successfully completed software development for delivery of 10 pre-production units. Software lead for an embedded PIC32 application in the consumer industry. Integrated the microcontroller with a Wi-Fi controller and cloud service for data management and over the air updates. Created bootloader for receiving application image packets from Ayla Cloud Services and storing in a dual buffer arrangement. Developed controller system to manage frequency and phase of an ultrasonic welder used for fabric manufacturing. Produced a tunable sinusoidal signal from discrete digital outputs in the 5-10 MHz range. Troubleshot signal quality issues on the custom driver board in order to improve functionality. Contributed to rapid design and iteration of analog circuit design to monitor power in the electric grid system. Overcame environmental and longevity challenges in order to bring a suite of sensors to a previously unmonitored sector. Completed initial EMC and ESD testing with an outside test house. Generated requirements for a proposed new medical device application.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering/Research Intern
positions.description: Improved and validated manufacturing processes in compliance with an ISO 13485 compliant quality system. Developed new test fixtures using the design control process. Led projects through all stages of the product lifecycle, including risk management, requirements identification, software and hardware design and verification. Synthesized input from management, regulatory, QA and other engineers on a multidisciplinary team to solve problems.

positions.title: Chief of EMS
positions.description: Respond to medical emergencies on campus to provide critical care. As Chief of WPI EMS, manage three EMS officers and the general membership in order to maintain the highest level of care. Guide long-term development of the squad and communications between our own agency and outside agencies of WPI Police, Worcester EMS and Worcester Fire.

positions.title: Personnel Lieutenant
positions.description: As Personnel Lieutenant, manage personnel and communications between our own agency and WPI Police, Worcester EMS and Worcester Fire.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical and Computer Engineering; Biomedical Engineering

projects.title: Major Qualifying Project
projects.description: Design and implement a device to monitor blood flow in the microvasculature of free tissue flap transplants on a team of five students. Provide physiological signals, from Doppler ultrasound, temperature and pH sensors, for surgeons remotely via a smartphone application. Develop project constraints and objectives in conjunction with doctors from University of Massachusetts Medical Center. Create prototypes for evaluation and validation.
